title: Hotels with an Eiffel Tower view: which room to book
metaDescription: Seven Paris hotels that sell rooms with an Eiffel Tower view, with the exact room category to book and the look-alike rooms that don't come with the view.
h1: Hotels with an Eiffel Tower view, and which room to book
dek: Seven Paris hotels that sell rooms with the tower in view. For each one we list the exact room category to book, and the ones that sound similar but don't come with the view.
teaser: From a rooftop suite across the Seine to a three-star double in the 15th.

shortAnswer.room: Superior Room, 1 Queen Bed, Tower (High Floor, Eiffel Tower View)

decoder.text: At the Shangri-La Paris, the “Paris View” suites are sold with a city view. Only the categories with “Eiffel” in the name come with the tower.
At the Pullman, the Deluxe rooms see the tower from the balcony. For the tower from inside the room, book the Superior Room, Tower (High Floor, Eiffel Tower View).
None of the room types that Novotel Paris Centre Tour Eiffel lists on Hotels.com mentions an Eiffel Tower view.

book.room: Superior Room, 1 Queen Bed, Tower (High Floor, Eiffel Tower View)
book.note: Also sold with 2 single beds. The listing photo captioned “View from room” belongs to this category.

book.room: Deluxe Room, 1 King Bed, Balcony (Eiffel Tower View)
book.note: Also sold as a twin and as a high-floor “Tower” version. Another booking site describes it as a Trocadéro view, with the tower from the balcony.

book.room: Suite, 1 King Bed with Sofa bed, Balcony (Eiffel Tower View)

skip.room: Classic Room, 1 Double Bed, Garden View
skip.note: Every Classic category is sold with a garden view, with or without a balcony.

alternatives.title: Book a table instead
alternatives.text: No view room in the budget? The Peninsula's rooftop restaurant, L'Oiseau Blanc, looks out at the tower, according to France's official tourism site.

faq.q: Which Paris hotels sell rooms with an Eiffel Tower view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: Pullman Paris Tour Eiffel, Shangri-La Paris, The Peninsula Paris, Le Metropolitan Paris Tour Eiffel, First Hotel Paris Tour Eiffel, Mercure Paris Centre Tour Eiffel and Splendid Hotel. Each sells specific room categories with the view. Their other rooms don't promise it.

faq.q: Does a hotel next to the tower guarantee the view?
faq.a: No. The Pullman is a 3-minute walk from the tower, and its Classic rooms are still sold with a garden view. Book the category that names the view.

faq.q: Which hotel has the most Eiffel view room types?
faq.a: Shangri-La Paris, with four: Eiffel View Room, Terrace Eiffel View Room, Duplex Eiffel View Suite and Duplex Terrace Eiffel View Suite.
